description: Check every ERC-20 a Robinhood Chain wallet holds in one call. Returns { wallet, truncated, checked, flaggedCount, tokens }: each token has address, symbol, balance { raw, decimals }, valueUsd when known, the same Trnch verdict as trnch_check { status, category, rugged, dumped }, official (ETH, WETH, USDG and official assets are listed without a Trnch check), flagged, canSell (false only for a confirmed honeypot) and, for a flagged token that can be sold, a sell hint: the trnch_sell call to make and a trnch.fun/trade link. Flagged tokens come first. At most 100 non-official tokens are returned, flagged first, then tokens with no known price, then the most valuable (truncated: true when more are held). Cached 60 s per wallet. No key needed. A signal, never a guarantee.
name: trnch_scan_wallet
title: Scan a wallet for flagged tokens
